- **SARS Practitioner Number:** Registered SARS Tax Practitioner PR-0098553
- **CIPC Registered Agent:** Authorized lodging agent for all corporate filings under the Companies Act 71 of 2008.

## 2. Core Practice Pillars

### Pillar 1: Accounting & Outsourced CFO Services
- **Monthly Accounting & Bookkeeping:** Capturing bank transactions, accounts payable/receivable, monthly bank reconciliations (ABSA, FNB, Nedbank, Standard Bank, Capitec, TymeBank), general ledger reconciliation, and management accounts.
- **Annual Financial Statements (AFS):** Preparation and compilation of IFRS and IFRS for SMEs compliant financial statements for private companies, close corporations, and trusts under Section 30 of the Companies Act. Turnaround: 7–10 business days.
- **Fractional CFO & Advisory:** Cash flow forecasting, budget variance reporting, breakeven analysis, strategic financial management for growing enterprises.
- **Cloud Accounting Setup & Migration:** Official partner services for Xero, Sage Business Cloud Accounting, QuickBooks Online, Pastel, and Zoho Books.
- **Dedicated Hub:** https://www.myacc.co.za/monthly-accounting
- **AFS Hub:** https://www.myacc.co.za/annual-financial-statements
- **Bookkeeping Hub:** https://www.myacc.co.za/bookkeeping-services

### Pillar 2: Tax & SARS Dispute Resolution
- **VAT Registration:** Fast-track Value-Added Tax applications with SARS for mandatory (turnover > R1,000,000) and voluntary (turnover > R50,000) qualifying businesses. Pre-audit of trade invoices, bank statements, lease agreements, and interview support. URL: https://www.myacc.co.za/vat-registration-south-africa
- **SARS Compromise of Debt (Section 200):** Legal negotiation under Section 200 of the Tax Administration Act (TAA) to write off significant portions of individual and corporate tax debt based on demonstrable inability to pay and asset evaluation. URL: https://www.myacc.co.za/sars-compromise
- **SARS Disputes & Objections (Section 104):** Lodging formal Notice of Objections (NOO), drafting legal arguments, submitting condonations for late disputes, noting Section 107 appeals to the Tax Board/Court, and Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR). URL: https://www.myacc.co.za/sars-disputes
- **Remission of Penalties & Interest (RFR01):** Submitting Request for Remission applications under Chapter 15 of the TAA to cancel administrative non-compliance penalties and late payment charges. URL: https://www.myacc.co.za/remission-of-fines
- **Statutory Tax Filing:** Company Income Tax (ITR14), Individual Income Tax (ITR12), Provisional Tax (IRP6), Monthly VAT (VAT201).
- **Tax Clearance Status (TCS PIN):** Obtaining and verifying good standing tax compliance status PINs for tenders, FIA foreign investments, and good standing certificates.

### Pillar 3: Payroll Administration & Labour Compliance
- **Monthly Payroll Outsourcing:** Full gross-to-net payroll processing, BCEA-compliant digital PDF payslips, EMP201 declarations (PAYE, UIF, SDL) submitted before the 7th of every month. URL: https://www.myacc.co.za/monthly-payroll
- **COIDA Letter of Good Standing:** Compensation Fund registration, annual Return of Earnings (ROE / W.As.8) submissions, assessment settlement, and 24-48 hour certificate renewals for tenders and construction sites. URL: https://www.myacc.co.za/coida-letter-of-good-standing
- **UIF & SDL Compliance:** Department of Employment and Labour uFiling declarations, employee UI-19 registrations, and Skills Development Levies management. URL: https://www.myacc.co.za/uif-compliance
- **Bi-Annual EMP501 Reconciliations:** SARS e@syFile reconciliations (interim September, annual May), generation and distribution of IRP5/IT3(a) employee tax certificates.

### Pillar 4: Company Secretarial & CIPC Compliance
- **Corporate Secretarial Practice:** Full statutory governance under the South African Companies Act 71 of 2008. Maintenance of statutory company registers, minute books, shareholder resolutions, and compliance calendars. URL: https://www.myacc.co.za/company-secretarial-services-south-africa
- **CIPC Beneficial Ownership Register:** Mandatory compliance under the General Laws Amendment Act 22 of 2022. Identification of 5%+ ultimate natural person beneficial owners, drafting BO mandate forms, compiling securities registers, and filing official BO registers with CIPC to avoid up to R1M in penalties or frozen bank accounts. URL: https://www.myacc.co.za/cipc-beneficial-ownership-register-south-africa
- **Pty Ltd Company Registration:** Name reservation, Memorandum of Incorporation (MOI), CoR14.3 registration certificate, income tax registration, and official banking confirmation letter within 3–7 business days. URL: https://www.myacc.co.za/company-registration
- **CIPC Annual Returns & FAS:** Calculation of turnover-based filing fees, Financial Accountability Supplement (FAS) or AFS submissions, preventing company deregistration.
- **Director Amendments (CoR39):** Appointment, resignation, or updating details of directors with formal CIPC CoR39 certificates and director consent resolutions.
- **Company Reinstatement:** Reinstating deregistered entities back to "In Business" status with CIPC.
- **Share Registers & Share Certificates:** Allotment and transfer of shares, issuing compliant share certificates.
- **Registered Office Changes (CoR21.1):** Updating legal address with CIPC and SARS.
- **Voluntary Liquidations:** Solvent winding-up under Section 80 of the Companies Act. URL: https://www.myacc.co.za/liquidations
